They just had 2 safe all delivery systems with a yasuo for follow up engage, which allows corki to do maximum damage event though the range on it corki is pretty short.

Ingame itself: as long as gambit stayed a bit even they would instantly win once alistar / gragas got some MR, but it never even got to that point. Cabochard got fed and destroyed SK.
